cpp.languageServer.description: Run clangd for C and C++ documents of trusted workspaces.

cpp.clangd.path.description: The clangd to run: a name looked up on PATH, or a path. Empty: the clangd that comes with IED (Settings > Languages shows which runs).

cpp.lldb.path.description: CodeLLDB's debug adapter: a name looked up on PATH, or the path of a codelldb.exe (the vscode-lldb extension's adapter folder has one). Empty: the CodeLLDB that comes with IED, else one IED installed, else codelldb on PATH.
